paragraphs: We are a multi-state diversified regional bank holding company organized under Maryland law in 1966 and headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. Through the Bank, we are committed to making people's lives better, helping businesses thrive, and strengthening the communities we serve, and we have been servicing the financial needs of our customers since 1866. Through our subsidiaries, we provide full-service commercial and consumer deposit, lending, and other banking and financial services. These include, but are not limited to, payments, mortgage banking, direct and indirect consumer financing, investment banking, capital markets, advisory, equipment financing, distribution finance, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance, and other financial products and services. As of December 31, 2025, we operated more than 1,000 branches in 14 states. Following the completion of our merger with Cadence Bank on February 1, 2026, as further discussed below, we operate nearly 1,400 branches in 21 states, with certain businesses operating in extended geographies.

On October 20, 2025, Huntington completed the acquisition of Veritex Holdings, Inc. ("Veritex," and such transaction, the "Veritex Merger"), a bank holding company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, whereby Veritex merged with and into Huntington, with Huntington as the surviving entity, and Veritex Community Bank merged with and into Huntington National Bank, with Huntington National Bank as the surviving entity. The transaction, which was valued at $1.7 billion, added $12.0 billion in assets, including $9.3 billion in loans, and $10.5 billion in deposits, as of the date of acquisition.

On February 1, 2026, Huntington completed the acquisition of Cadence Bank ("Cadence," and such transaction, the "Cadence Merger"), a regional bank headquartered in Houston, Texas and Tupelo, Mississippi, whereby Cadence merged with and into Huntington National Bank, with Huntington National Bank as the surviving bank. Under the terms of the agreement (the "Cadence Merger Agreement"), Huntington issued 2.475 shares for each outstanding share of Cadence in a 100% stock transaction. Based on Huntington's closing price of $17.48 as of January 30, 2026, the consideration is valued at approximately $8.1 billion. Each outstanding share of 5.50% Series A Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock of Cadence was converted into the right to receive 1/1000 of a share of a newly created 5.50% Series L Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock of Huntington. As of December 31, 2025, Cadence had $54 billion in assets, including $37 billion in loans, and $44 billion in deposits.

Our business segments are based on our internally aligned segment leadership structure, which is how management monitors results and assesses performance. For each business segment, we expect the combination of our business model, investment in products and capabilities, and exceptional service to provide a competitive advantage that supports revenue and earnings growth. Our business model emphasizes the delivery of a complete set of banking products and services offered by larger banks, but distinguished by local delivery and customer service.

A key strategic emphasis has been for our business segments to operate in cooperation to provide products and services to our customers and to build stronger and more profitable relationships using our OCR sales and service process, which aligns to our vision to be the leading people-first, customer-centered bank in the country. The objectives of OCR are to:
•Use a consultative and advisory sales approach to provide solutions that are specific to each customer;
•Leverage each business segment in terms of its products and expertise to benefit customers; and
•Develop prospects who may want to have multiple products and services as part of their relationship with us.
Following is a description of our two business segments, Consumer & Regional Banking and Commercial Banking, along with the Treasury / Other function:

•Consumer & Regional Banking: The Consumer & Regional Banking segment provides a wide array of financial products and services to consumer and business customers including, but not limited to, deposits, lending, payments, mortgage banking, dealer financing, investment management, trust, brokerage, insurance, and other financial products and services. We serve our customers through our network of regional banking and national specialty finance channels, including branches and ATMs, online and mobile banking, our customer call centers, and strategic national partnerships.

We have a "Fair Play" banking philosophy: providing differentiated products and services, built on a strong foundation of customer-friendly products and advocacy. Our brand resonates with consumers and businesses, helping us acquire new customers and deepen relationships with current customers. Our Fair Play banking suite of products includes 24-Hour Grace®, Asterisk-Free Checking®, Money Scout®, $50 Safety Zone®, Standby Cash®, Early Pay, Instant Access, Savings Goal Getter®, and Huntington Heads Up®.

Consumer & Regional Banking offers a comprehensive set of digitally powered consumer and business financial solutions to Consumer Finance, Regional Banking, Branch Banking, and Wealth Management customers.

Consumer Finance provides direct and indirect consumer loans, as well as dealer finance loans and deposits. Direct consumer loan products, including mortgage and home equity, are originated through branch, online, and third-party channels. Indirect consumer loans are originated through deep relationships with dealerships to finance consumer purchases of automobiles, recreational vehicles, marine craft, and powersports. We also provide dealer finance loans (including floorplan loans), deposits, and other financial products to these dealerships and their owners.

Regional Banking, along with our business and specialty banking offerings, is a dynamic part of our business. Regional Banking is defined as serving small to mid-sized businesses. Beyond conventional lending solutions, Huntington offers access to capital markets, practice finance, and SBA lending capabilities. In addition, our payments business provides credit and debit cards and treasury management services to our customers. Huntington continues to develop products and services that are designed specifically to meet the needs of business customers and looks for ways to help companies find solutions to their financing needs.

paragraphs: In 2025, we reported net income of $2.2 billion, or $1.39 per diluted common share, compared with net income in 2024 of $1.9 billion, or $1.22 per diluted common share. The current year reported net income was impacted by acquisition-related expenses totaling $168 million, or $129 million after tax, which reduced diluted earnings by $0.09 per common share.

Net interest income was $6.0 billion in 2025, an increase of $646 million, or 12%, from 2024. FTE net interest income, a non-GAAP financial measure, increased $658 million, or 12%, from 2024. The increase in FTE net interest income reflected a 13 basis point increase in the FTE NIM to 3.13% and a $13.9 billion, or 8%, increase in average earning assets, partially offset by a $12.9 billion, or 9%, increase in average interest-bearing liabilities. The NIM increase was primarily due to a decrease in the cost of funding, partially offset by a decrease in yields on earning assets and net hedging activity.

The provision for credit losses increased $43 million, or 10%, to $463 million for 2025. The ACL was $2.7 billion, or 1.83% of total loans and leases, at December 31, 2025, compared to $2.4 billion, or 1.88% of total loans and leases, at December 31, 2024. The increase in the ACL was driven by current year loan and lease growth, in addition to an ACL recorded for loans acquired in the Veritex transaction, partially offset by a decrease in the overall ACL coverage ratio.

Noninterest income was $2.2 billion, an increase of $135 million, or 7%, from the prior year, driven by a $24 million gain on the sale of a portion of our trust and custody business and increases in customer deposit and loan fees, wealth and asset management revenue, payments and cash management revenue, and capital markets and advisory fees, partially offset by an increase in net losses on sales of securities. Noninterest expense was $5.0 billion, an increase of $453 million, or 10%, from the prior year primarily due to higher personnel costs and outside data processing and other services, in addition to $168 million of acquisition-related expenses, partially offset by lower deposit insurance expense driven by a reduction in the amount of expense associated with the FDIC DIF special assessment due to ongoing adjustments to uninsured deposit losses by the FDIC.

paragraphs: 本公司為一間跨州的多元化地區性銀行控股公司，根據馬裏蘭州法律於1966年設立，總部設於俄亥俄州哥倫布市。透過銀行，本公司致力於改善人們的生活，協助企業成長，並強化我們服務的社區，自1866年起，我們便持續為客戶提供財務服務。透過我們的子公司，我們提供完整的商業與消費者存款、貸款及其他銀行與金融服務。這些服務包括但不限於：付款、房貸銀行、直接與間接消費者融資、投資銀行、資本市場、顧問服務、設備融資、分銷融資、投資管理、信託、證券經紀、保險及其他金融產品與服務。截至2025年12月31日，我們在14個州經營超過1,000家分行。在2026年2月1日完成與Cadence Bank的合併後，如後文進一步說明，我們在21個州經營近1,400家分行，部分業務運作範圍延伸至更廣的地理區域。

2025年10月20日，Huntington完成對Veritex Holdings, Inc.（"Veritex"，此交易稱為"Veritex Merger"）的收購，Veritex為一家總部設於德克薩斯州達拉斯的銀行控股公司，透過此交易，Veritex與Huntington合併，Huntington為存續公司，且Veritex Community Bank與Huntington National Bank合併，Huntington National Bank為存續銀行。此交易價值17億美元，於收購日時，增加了120億美元的資產，包括930億美元的貸款，以及1050億美元的存款。

2026年2月1日，Huntington完成對Cadence Bank（"Cadence"，此交易稱為"Cadence Merger"）的收購，Cadence為一家總部設於德克薩斯州休士頓與密西西比州圖佩洛的地區性銀行，透過此交易，Cadence與Huntington National Bank合併，Huntington National Bank為存續銀行。根據協議（"Cadence Merger Agreement"），Huntington發行2.475股股票，換取Cadence每一股普通股。根據Huntington於2026年1月30日收市價17.48美元計算，交易價值約為81億美元。Cadence每一股5.50% Series A 非累積永續優先股轉換為擁有1/1000股新創立的5.50% Series L 非累積永續優先股之權利。截至2025年12月31日，Cadence擁有5400億美元資產，包括3700億美元貸款，以及4400億美元存款。
我們的業務分部係根據我們內部對齊的分部領導結構設置，這是管理階層監測結果與評估績效的方式。對每個業務分部，我們預期透過我們的業務模式、對產品與能力的投資，以及卓越的服務，提供競爭優勢，以支持營業收入與獲利成長。我們的業務模式強調提供較大型銀行所提供的完整銀行產品與服務，但透過本地化交付與客戶服務加以區隔。
我們的業務分部重點之一為透過合作運作，為客戶提供產品與服務，並建立更強健且更具盈利性的客戶關係，透過我們的OCR銷售與服務流程，此流程與我們成為國家首屈一指的以人為本、以客戶為中心的銀行的願景一致。OCR的目標為：
• 透過諮詢與顧問式銷售方式，為每位客戶提供具體解決方案；
• 透過各業務分部的產品與專業知識，為客戶帶來益處；以及
• 發展可能希望與我們建立多重產品與服務關係的潛在客戶。
以下為本公司兩大業務分部，即消費者及區域銀行業與商業銀行業，以及財務部/其他功能之說明：
•消費者及區域銀行業：消費者及區域銀行業分部為消費者及企業客戶提供廣泛的金融產品與服務，包括但不限於存款、貸款、支付、房貸銀行、經銷商融資、投資管理、信託、證券經紀、保險及其他金融產品與服務。本公司透過區域銀行與全國專業金融通路網路服務客戶，包括分行與提款機、網際網路與行動銀行、客戶客服中心，以及戰略性國家合作夥伴。

本公司秉持「公平競賽」的銀行經營理念：提供差異化產品與服務，建立在強大的客戶友好型產品與倡導基礎之上。本公司品牌與消費者及企業客戶產生共鳴，協助本公司獲得新客戶並深化與現有客戶的關係。本公司「公平競賽」銀行產品組合包括 24-Hour Grace®、Asterisk-Free Checking®、Money Scout®、$50 Safety Zone®、Standby Cash®、Early Pay、Instant Access、Savings Goal Getter®，以及 Huntington Heads Up®。
消費者及區域銀行業為消費者金融、區域銀行、分行銀行及資產管理客戶提供全面的數位驅動型消費者及企業金融解決方案。
消費者金融提供直接與間接消費者貸款，以及經銷商融資貸款與存款。直接消費者貸款產品（包括房貸與住宅貸款）透過分行、網際網路與第三方通路發放。間接消費者貸款透過與經銷商的深度關係，用以融資消費者購買新車、休閒車、船隻與動力運動器材。本公司亦為這些經銷商及其所有者提供經銷商融資貸款（包括庫存貸款）、存款及其他金融產品。
區域銀行業與本公司企業及專業銀行業產品與服務共同構成本公司業務的重要部分。區域銀行業被定義為服務小型至中型企業。除了傳統貸款解決方案，Huntington 提供資本市場接入、實務金融及 SBA 貸款能力。此外，本公司支付業務為客戶提供信用卡與提款卡及財務管理服務。Huntington 繼續開發專為企業客戶需求設計的產品與服務，並尋找協助公司解決融資需求的方法。

paragraphs: 2025 年，本公司報表淨收入為 22 億美元，或每股稀釋普通股 1.39 美元，較 2024 年的淨收入 19 億美元，或每股稀釋普通股 1.22 美元為高。本年報表淨收入受到合併相關費用 1.68 億美元，或稅後 1.29 億美元的影響，使每股普通股稀釋收益減少 0.09 美元。

2025 年淨利息收入為 60 億美元，較 2024 年增加 6.46 億美元，或成長 12%。FTE 淨利息收入，為非 GAAP 財務指標，較 2,024 年增加 6.58 億美元，或成長 12%。FTE 淨利息收入的增加反映 FTE NIM 增加 13 基點至 3.13%，以及平均獲利資產增加 1,390 億美元，或成長 8%，部分抵銷平均利息負擔資產增加 1,290 億美元，或成長 9%。NIM 的增加主要由於資金成本下降，部分抵銷獲利資產收益率下降及淨避險活動。

2025 年信貸減損提撥增加 4,300 萬美元，或成長 10%，至 4.63 億美元。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，ACL 為 27 億美元，或總貸款及租賃的 1.83%，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 24 億美元，或總貸款及租賃的 1.88% 為高。ACL 的增加主要由於本年貸款及租賃成長，以及因 Veritex 交易取得貸款所記錄的 ACL，部分抵銷總體 ACL 覆蓋比率下降。

非利息收入為 22 億美元，較前一年增加 13.5 億美元，或成長 7%，主要由於出售部分信託及保管業務所產生的 2,400 萬美元收益，以及客戶存款及貸款費用、財富及資產管理收入、付款及現金管理收入，以及資本市場及顧問費用增加，部分抵銷證券銷售淨損失增加。非利息費用為 50 億美元，較前一年增加 45.3 億美元，或成長 10%，主要由於人力成本及外部資料處理及其他服務費用增加，以及 1.68 億美元的合併相關費用，部分抵銷因 FDIC DIF 特別評估費用減少而導致的存款保險費用下降。
